savings_checklist.conditions: Applies every year. The online return is due 31 January after the tax year. The balancing payment and first payment on account are due 31 January, the second payment on account 31 July. If MTD-mandated, quarterly updates are due 7 August, 7 November, 7 February and 7 May.
savings_checklist.data_needed: payments on account, profit
savings_checklist.how_to_estimate: Old regime (Sch 55/56: 2023-24 to 2025-26, and 2026-27 if not MTD-mandated). Late return: £100 on day 1; from 3 months, £10 a day up to £900; at 6 months, the greater of 5% of tax due or £300; at 12 months, the same again (up to 70% or 100% if information was deliberately withheld). A return 12 months late with little tax due costs £1,600. Late balancing payment: 5% of tax unpaid 30 days after the due date, plus 5% more at 5 months and at 11 months after that penalty date. New regime (MTD-mandated from 2026-27; all SA filers from 2027-28 if commenced): 1 point per late submission, with £200 at 4 points (quarterly) or 2 points (annual) and £200 for each further miss. Late payment: 3% of tax unpaid at day 15, 3% more at day 30, then 10% a year accruing daily from day 31 (2026-27; 4%/4% announced for 2027-28). Interest on all late tax, including payments on account: Bank Rate + 4%, charged daily at the rate in force each day (7.75% from 9 January 2026; 8.00% from 24 November 2026). Always label results as estimates.
savings_checklist.risks: A reasonable excuse must be evidenced (perrin-v-hmrc) and acted on promptly once it ends. Lack of funds is not an excuse. Asking HMRC for a payment plan by day 30, and keeping to the plan they agree, avoids all three Sch 56 penalties (asking later avoids the later ones); interest still runs. Penalties and interest are never deductible. Appeal within 30 days.

savings_checklist.title: Disclose judgment calls and keep records to limit HMRC's reach
savings_checklist.legal_basis: langham-v-veltema, tma-s29, tma-s34, tma-s36, tma-s12b, burgess-brimheath, hmrc-v-harte, fa2007-sch24, hamish-taylor-v-hmrc
savings_checklist.conditions: Use for any judgment call: a long engagement treated as temporary, home-as-base travel, the car method, apportionments.
savings_checklist.data_needed: expenses by category, mileage trips, stays, job days
savings_checklist.how_to_estimate: Not a cash saving. It cuts the exposure window from 6 or 20 years to 4, and unprompted disclosure can cut a careless penalty to 0%.
savings_checklist.risks: The disclosure must be enough to make a hypothetical officer aware of the insufficiency. Never leave income out.

savings_checklist.title: Protect self-employed status, and the expense deductions that go with it, engagement by engagement
savings_checklist.legal_basis: hall-v-lorimer, hmrc-v-pgmol-uksc, hmrc-v-atholl-house, hmrc-v-s-l-barnes, esm4120, esm4115, esm4116, esm4117, esm0551, esm0553, itepa-ss44-47
savings_checklist.conditions: Each booking is tested on its own. Long, exclusive, rolling or first-call engagements with one company carry the most risk. Agency bookings with supervision, direction or control are PAYE.
savings_checklist.data_needed: job days, expenses by category, profit
savings_checklist.how_to_estimate: Not a saving calculation. Track distinct clients and POs per year, booking lengths, each client's share of income and days, late or unpaid invoices, own kit used, and whether kit is paid separately in the PO. Flag any client providing over half of the year's days or income for a long period.
savings_checklist.risks: Status cannot be chosen. A booking that is really employment loses trading deductions and belongs on the employment pages. NI-only or PAYE deductions on a booking show the engager treated it as employment.

savings_checklist.title: Claim pre-trading expenses (new trade only)
savings_checklist.conditions: Costs in the 7 years before the trade started that would have been deductible after it started.
savings_checklist.data_needed: expenses by category, equipment purchases
savings_checklist.how_to_estimate: Sum the qualifying pre-start costs and deduct them on the first day of trading.
savings_checklist.risks: Only for a new trade. Private assets brought in later get WDAs at market value (CAA s13), not AIA.

how_to_use: Built from items each checked against an official source by two independent checkers (2026-11-23). Cite only items with citable=true, with their url. Developments with status announced or proposed are not law yet. Not legal advice: anything near the planning boundary needs an accountant or tax adviser.
